$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: CheckboxGroup
whenToUse: Several related yes/no choices that form one value (“Notify me by: Email, SMS”).
Up to about 8 options people should see at once.

whenNotToUse.text: Unrelated settings that only share a page

anatomy.description: `CheckboxGroupItem`; its `name` is what lands in the value array.
`size` sm/md flows to every item and sets the gap.

do.caption: One legend, one value; the question is asked once.
do.example:
<CheckboxGroup label="Notify me by" defaultValue={['email']}>
  <CheckboxGroupItem name="email" label="Email" />
  <CheckboxGroupItem name="sms" label="SMS" />
  <CheckboxGroupItem name="push" label="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>

dont.caption: Loose boxes repeat the question in every label and lose the group name for screen readers.

a11y: The legend is read with each option — keep it short and question-like.
Each item is its own tab stop; Space toggles.
An error for the whole group goes under the group and is linked with `aria-describedby`, not on one box.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every child Checkbox at once.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label — rendered as a <legend> via the native fieldset.

props.name: size
props.description: Checkbox size for every item, unless an item overrides its own. Defaults to "md".

props.name: description
props.description: Small helper text below the label — only rendered when `label` is set.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Convenience for checked="indeterminate" — shows a dash instead of a checkmark.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown next to the box. Omit for a bare checkbox with no text.
